verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships its own AI agent (Rudder AI in Slack), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair axis for this product. The evidence, however, only documents RudderStack acting as an MCP server that external clients like Claude or Cursor connect to. That is the opposite role and does not count here, and nothing shows RudderStack consuming third-party MCP servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
